Mirazh Company · BIM & Project Management Consulting

BIM-enabled project management and civil engineering consulting.

Mirazh Company delivers coordinated 3D modelling, clash detection, quantity take-off and schedule simulation for construction projects across Iraq and the Kurdistan Region — as a remote consulting service, with site visits scheduled around your project's milestones.

Most construction here is still delivered from 2D drawings and manual bills of quantity — with disputes and rework as the result. We replace that with one coordinated BIM model as the single source for scope, schedule and cost.
